title: Scope
description: Where an object belongs. Six scope types, per DIV-3. A company is not a scope: it is an Entity with entity_type=COMPANY, addressed by scope_type=ENTITY. The live database still accepts only four of these six; Brain-V1-A runs no migration and nothing may assume otherwise until Brain-V1-B.

scope_id.description: Identifier within the scope type. GLOBAL_VORQUEL uses the literal GLOBAL, which keeps the global scope from being addressable by any other id.
